model.name: MiniMax H3 FastH3 Omni NVFP4 QAD 8-Step 20B
model.description: Generates synchronized video and audio from text and your references in 8 steps, with the Ref2VA inputs: ordered images, videos and audio clips, start/end images, frame injection, reference or control videos, soundtracks and continuation. The smallest FastH3 Omni (13 GB, lowest VRAM): NVFP4 weights trained for 4-bit inference, fastest on RTX 50xx FP4 tensor cores, slower on RTX 30xx/40xx. Distilled with references: best with at least one image or video reference.

prompt:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the character from <Picture 1>.
summary: [reference generation] The referenced character explores a lush tropical forest.
retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain identity and clothing while changing the setting.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] <Subject 1> walks between giant ferns, looks up at a colorful bird and smiles. The camera tracks alongside at eye level in soft morning light.
overall_soundscape: Bird calls, rustling leaves and gentle footsteps.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
